name: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – CDO Leg 3
short_description: A multi-distance race event, including a half-marathon, set for September 20, 2026 at SM City CDO Uptown in Cagayan de Oro, Philippines.
ai_summary: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – CDO Leg 3 is a half-marathon-anchored race scheduled for September 20, 2026, in Cagayan de Oro, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia brand, the event will be based at SM City CDO Uptown and offers multiple distance options: 32km, 21.1km (the primary distance), 10km, and 5km. Registration details have not yet been announced.
